most_likely: Iron deficiency anemia due to chronic occult gastrointestinal blood loss
summary: Elderly man with CAD s/p 2 stents, atrial fibrillation on warfarin (INR 2.4 on arrival), sick sinus syndrome s/p pacemaker, mild-moderate aortic stenosis and known Barrett's esophagus presents with symptomatic acute-on-chronic macrocytic anemia (Hgb 6.7), dyspnea on exertion and fatigue after outpatient labs. Iron studies show marked iron deficiency (Fe 15, ferritin 27, TIBC 306) despite two recent Feraheme infusions; one guaiac-positive stool on the floor, but extensive prior EGD/colonoscopy/capsule showed only Barrett's esophagus and gastritis without active bleeding. He was transfused 3 units PRBC (discharge Hgb 8.7), given IV iron and started on B12 repletion (B12 255, low-normal), with hematology follow-up and planned bone marrow biopsy for the unexplained macrocytic component.
